compiled.content: <xsl:stylesheet xmlns:fn0="urn:lattice:mork-transforms" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" version="3.0" exclude-result-prefixes="#all"><xsl:output method="text" encoding="UTF-8" /><xsl:function name="fn0:literal" as="xs:string"><xsl:param name="s" as="xs:string" /><xsl:sequence select="'"' || replace(replace(replace(replace($s, '\\', '\\\\'), '"', '\\"'), codepoints-to-string(10), '\\n'), codepoints-to-string(13), '\\r') || '"'" /></xsl:function><xsl:template match="/"><xsl:variable name="lines" as="xs:string*"><xsl:for-each select="/Q{urn:example:policy}policies/Q{urn:example:policy}policy"><xsl:if test="exists(@Q{}number)"><xsl:variable name="n1" select="'<' || 'urn:lattice:studio:mapping/policy/' || encode-for-uri(string((@Q{}number)[1])) || '>'" as="xs:string" /><xsl:sequence select="$n1 || ' ' || '<http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type>' || ' ' || '<urn:example:target#Policy>' || ' .'" /><xsl:for-each select="Q{urn:example:policy}holder"><xsl:sequence select="$n1 || ' ' || '<urn:example:target#holderName>' || ' ' || fn0:literal(string(.)) || ' .'" /></xsl:for-each><xsl:sequence select="'<urn:example:target#Acme>' || ' ' || '<urn:example:target#insures>' || ' ' || $n1 || ' .'" /><xsl:sequence select="$n1 || ' ' || '<urn:example:target#status>' || ' ' || '"active"' || ' .'" /><xsl:for-each select="Q{urn:example:policy}cover"><xsl:variable name="n2" select="'<' || 'urn:lattice:studio:mapping/cover/' || string-join(for $a in ancestor-or-self::* return encode-for-uri(local-name($a)) || '/' || (count($a/preceding-sibling::*[node-name(.) eq node-name($a)]) + 1), '/') || '>'" as="xs:string" /><xsl:sequence select="$n2 || ' ' || '<http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type>' || ' ' || '<urn:example:target#Cover>' || ' .'" /><xsl:sequence select="$n2 || ' ' || '<urn:example:target#coverOf>' || ' ' || $n1 || ' .'" /><xsl:for-each select="Q{urn:example:policy}code"><xsl:if test="string(.) = ('FIRE', 'FLOOD')"><xsl:sequence select="$n2 || ' ' || '<urn:example:target#peril>' || ' ' || (if (string(.) eq 'FIRE') then '<urn:example:target#Fire>' else if (string(.) eq 'FLOOD') then '<urn:example:target#Flood>' else '') || ' .'" /></xsl:if></xsl:for-each></xsl:for-each></xsl:if></xsl:for-each></xsl:variable><xsl:for-each select="sort(distinct-values($lines), 'http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions/collation/codepoint')"><xsl:value-of select=". || codepoints-to-string(10)" /></xsl:for-each></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>
